note: Two reusable rule candidates came out of the story-028 review findings; no fallow or complaint signal was present.

candidates.text: When overriding styles of a shared component from a parent, match the component's scoped class selectors rather than bare element selectors so the override survives the component's own hover and state styles.
candidates.rationale: The Remove button's rose color in TaskGroup was overridden by Button's text-variant hover because the global override targeted `button` while Button used `.btn-text:hover`. Targeting `.btn-text` preserved the override.

candidates.text: Test component events through the public Svelte API (e.g., a wrapper component) instead of relying on implementation-specific DOM event side effects.
candidates.rationale: Toggle originally dispatched a native DOM CustomEvent solely so the test could use addEventListener. Using a ToggleTestWrapper to wire `on:change` removed that coupling and let the DOM-event branch be deleted.
